intro: Ka raadi dukaan magaciisa ama koodhkiisa. Ama fur dukaankaaga oo billow iibinta.
noStores: Dukaan lama helin. Hubi magaca ama koodhka.
manualPaymentNotice: Lacagta waxaa si toos ah loo siiyaa iibiyaha. Adeeggu lacag ma qabto.
cachedWarning: Xog kaydsan: internet ma jiro. Qiimaha iyo kaydku way is beddeli karaan.
stockFinalAtAcceptance: Kaydka waxaa la xaqiijiyaa marka iibiyuhu aqbalo dalabka.
replaceCart: Dambiisha waxaa ku jira alaab dukaan kale. Ma beddelaysaa dambiisha?
stockLimit: Kaydka la arkay kuma filna. Cusboonaysii alaabta.
cartEstimate: Qiimahan waa qiyaas. Hubi wadarta cusub ka hor dalabka.
pendingCheckout: Natiijada dalabkii hore wali lama xaqiijin. Hubi ama ku celi isla dalabka; dalab cusub ha bilaabin.
reviewAgain: Hubi maqnaanshaha dalabka oo dib u eeg
acceptanceNotice: Dalabku wuxuu rasmi noqonayaa marka iibiyuhu aqbalo.
waitToPay: Ha bixin lacag ilaa iibiyuhu aqbalo dalabka.
trackingPrivacy: Furahan sir u hay. Qofkii haysta wuxuu arki karaa xogta kooban ee dalabka.
refundNotice: Iibiyuhu waa inuu lacagta kuu celiyo. Nidaamku si toos ah lacag uma celiyo.
payDirect: Bixi si toos ah iibiyaha adigoo adeegsanaya xogtan:
PAID: Lacag waa la helay — xaqiijinta iibiyaha
REFUND_REQUIRED: Lacag celin ayaa loo baahan yahay
REFUNDED: Lacagta waa la celiyey — xaqiijinta iibiyaha
verifyPayment: Akoonkaaga ka hubi lacagta. Xaqiiji keliya marka lacagta ama celintu dhab ahaan dhacday.
sellerIntro: Hal akoon, hal dukaan. Waxaad sidoo kale ka iibsan kartaa dukaamada kale.
name: Magac
createStoreIntro: Ku bilow magaca dukaanka iyo xogta xiriirka, gaarsiinta iyo lacag bixinta.
checklist: Dhammaystir xogta → Ku dar alaab → Daabac dukaanka → La wadaag koodhka.
storeSuspended: Maamuluhu wuu hakiyey dukaankan. Dalabyadii hore waad maamuli kartaa.
sellerConfirmedTotal: Wadarta lacagta iibiyuhu xaqiijiyey (aan la joojin)
deleteAccountWarning: Tani si joogto ah ayay u tirtiraysaa akoonkaaga. Magacaaga, iimaylkaaga, xiriirka dukaanka iyo faahfaahinta lacag-bixinta iyo sawirrada aad soo gelisay waa la tirtirayaa, dukaankaaga waa la qarinayaa, alaabtaadana waa la kaydinayaa. Diiwaannada dalabyadii hore waa la hayaa iyadoo aan lahayn xogtaada shakhsiyeed. Tan dib looma celin karo.
deleteAccountConfirm: Si joogto ah ma u tirtiraysaa akoonkaaga? Tan dib looma celin karo.
commaRegions: Ku kala saar hakad, tusaale Aag A, Aag B
photoHelp: Kaydi alaabta marka hore. Ugu badnaan 3 sawir, midkiiba 5 MB. JPEG, PNG ama WebP.
resetSent: Haddii akoonku jiro, fariin ayaa loo diray.
resetHelp: Ka soo guuri labada koodh fariinta iimaylka oo dooro furaha cusub.
linkUnavailable: Bogga lama furin. Hubi xiriirkaaga internetka.
sessionExpired: Fadhigu wuu dhacay. Mar kale soo gal.
connectionUnknown: Xiriirka lama xaqiijin. Hubi internetka oo mar kale isku day. Waxqabadkan looma tirin guul.
unexpectedError: Wax qalad ah ayaa dhacay. Mar kale isku day.
